name: fred_2yr_treasury
description:
The 2-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series DGS2 (percent, daily).
Returns {"series": "DGS2", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, number of newest observations; omitted: 60, although the schema default says 30).
Related: fred_5yr_treasury, fred_10yr_treasury, fred_30yr_treasury, fred_yield_spread; for any other FRED series use fred_custom_series.
Example: {"limit": 12}
API key: env FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); when unset the placeholder DEMO_KEY is sent.

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)
